summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O -- RepositoryIdentity + DeploymentBinding First-Use Proposition Preparation. FINAL VERDICT: FIRST-USE ARCHITECTURE REQUIRES SEPARATE IDENTITY TRANSITION (narrowly: RI-D is the selected, evidence-supported model, but this phase's own governing scope forbids real RepositoryIdentity creation, so RI-D's full-precision benefit is deferred one sub-phase, not abandoned). Proposition preparation / architecture materialization only -- no election. Independently reconstructed the Transition-2 dependency chain from primary source in this session (repository_identity.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py, hatp_class_b_conformance.py, hatp_mandatory_certification.py, HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md) rather than relying on 149O.20L.7M's prose as an oracle. Confirmed _generate_repository_identity() calls bare uuid.uuid4() with no caller-supplied-UUID parameter, no deterministic seed, and no persist-free preview mode; confirmed ensure_repository_identity() is idempotent (exists->unchanged, missing->generate-once, malformed->fail-closed); confirmed preview_create_deployment_binding()/create_deployment_binding() both require an already-persisted RepositoryIdentity and never call ensure_repository_identity() themselves (RepositoryIdentityMissingError otherwise) -- this is the load-bearing fact of the Repository-ID Preview Problem. Reproduced all of this in a disposable local simulation against synthetic tempfile.mkdtemp() directories (never the real Protected Root, never this repository's .pcae/): pre-identity preview failure reproduced exactly, idempotency confirmed across two ensure_repository_identity() calls, preview_create_deployment_binding() succeeded once identity existed with the exact candidate binding shape shown, create_deployment_binding() then exercised the exact deployment_binding_matches() logic HBDC-REQ-042's check calls and confirmed it flips to True under a matching synthetic pair, and a retry with identical authority fields confirmed idempotent-preserve (ALREADY_SATISFIED, no valid_from refresh) -- both tempdirs deleted at the end. SSH to hac-dell was reachable and used strictly read-only (via sudo -n as codex, then corrected to sudo -n -u pcae with the venv on PATH once an initial wrong-identity/wrong-PATH invocation was diagnosed as producing spurious extra failures): re-confirmed SHA b0840e96a7ffb12308e95828aa5927c3e7c770c0 exactly, detached, clean; RepositoryIdentity and DeploymentBinding both still absent; Protected Root exists, empty, root:pcae 0750; producer module importable and admin script --help-only confirmed, no create/rotate/revoke invoked; live HBDC diagnostic re-run as the correct pcae OS agent principal returned NON_COMPLIANT with exactly one residual (HBDC-REQ-042) across 34 total checks -- matches 149O.20L.7N.5's own finding exactly, no drift. Selected model RI-D: RepositoryIdentity creation as an unelected administrative prerequisite (independently reconfirmed to confer no authority whatsoever by itself, HATP-REQ-048/051, so it needs no election of its own -- rejecting RI-C's three-transition model as unnecessary election overhead) performed once, immediately before drafting an exact DeploymentBinding proposition against the now-real value -- exactly one election then governs DeploymentBinding creation only, with full field precision; rejected RI-B (would require new, unauthorized production code) and RI-A (strictly less precise than RI-D on the repository_id/canonical_deployment_root dimensions, with no compensating benefit) as inferior to RI-D on the same evidence. Disclosed, not silently absorbed, one deviation from 149O.20L.7M's own literal phase sketch: 7M's plan would have had this very phase (7O) create the real Dell RepositoryIdentity to realize RI-D's full precision immediately; this phase's own governing prompt explicitly forbids that, so RI-D's precision benefit is deferred to a revised, explicitly-inserted future sub-phase (149O.20L.7O.2) rather than achieved here. Resolved the 9-field DeploymentBinding schema exactly where source now permits: canonical_deployment_root is now read-only-resolvable (source already deployed, unlike at 7M's time) to /opt/pcae/runtime/src; repository_id bound by generation rule + a downstream equality invariant the producer already enforces structurally (no repository_id parameter exists on create_deployment_binding() at all); valid_from bound by generation rule only (_canonical_timestamp_now(), strict grammar); status/revoked_at confirmed 'active'/None on first creation. Explicitly declined to invent principal_id/signer_key_id/provider_profile/authority_scope -- no canonical derivation formula or registry exists anywhere in this repository for any of the four; each must be resolved as a genuine future administrative enrollment decision. Classified the carried-forward audit-durability gap (create_deployment_binding can durably mutate the trust store while an unrelated audit-emission exception propagates uncaught) as ACCEPTABLE NON-BLOCKING FIRST-USE RISK, conditional on an immediate post-mutation audit-presence re-verification discipline in the future execution phase, reasoned explicitly rather than carried forward unexamined. Classified the timestamp-parser gap and HMIC-REQ-103/HMIC-REQ-063 gaps as correctly out of scope for first creation, matching and independently re-deriving 7M's own dispositions. Independently proved RepositoryIdentity bytes fall structurally outside the 30-member HMIC digest scope (git-ignored, never enters the tracked tree the digest walks) and that the DeploymentBinding registry is even further outside scope (lives entirely outside this repository's filesystem tree, at /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store). Re-read chgr-0e37ed1340b14311826722c4dbf3e856's condition 6 and chgr-71bd24f9d3d742d6baac772e480fc876's condition 17 directly from their JSON records; confirmed neither authorizes RepositoryIdentity or DeploymentBinding creation, and a new, dedicated CHGR is required for the future DeploymentBinding election. Revised 149O.20L.7M's own future-phase decomposition (its own step 6 collapsed identity-creation into the preparation phase; this phase's own stricter scope requires splitting that into its own dedicated, independently-verified sub-phase, 149O.20L.7O.2, before the election). No RepositoryIdentity, DeploymentBinding, election, CHGR, certification, Boundary C, Boundary A, HATP activation, or Dell mutation of any kind performed.
